title: If a master carries any seaman to sea
text:
22. If a master carries any seaman to sea

without entering into an agreement with
him in accordance with this Act.

93 Fine which may extend
to two hundred rupees.

94 Fine which may extend
to one hundred rupees.

95(2),

96, 97

Fine which may extend

to one hundred rupees
for every seaman in
respect of whom the
offence is committed.
